== Notes ==
* Level 15 Elder Tigers and/or [[Crane]]s spawn outside [[Boreas Seabed (outpost)|Boreas Seabed]] in Pongmei Valley ready to be charmed by [[Yeti]] mobs. Flagging [[hero]]es, it is possible to kill/interrupt the mobs; allowing the player to charm the pet.
* Tigers deal [[slashing damage]].
* [[Zaishen Menagerie Grounds/Service costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Cantha)''
